comparison.objective: Rotate a hair dryer barrel-down and lower it into a tapered wall holster until supported.
comparison.physical_skill: Large-object reorientation, tapered insertion, gravity-supported release, and withdrawal.
comparison.success_condition: Dryer centered and sufficiently deep in the coil, coil bearing its load, robot contact absent, and released state held one second.
comparison.reason: Tests one-object tapered insertion and support transfer, not sieve agitation or material retention.
